drift_gate: PASS = combined majority agreement with E's stored votes >= 0.85 AND every panel model id still served AND track-H flag rate on original errors inside the 95% Wilson CI of E's 0.84. Providers pinned to those that served E (D-PIN). On FAIL: panel labels still produced but reported as DRIFTED (secondary); solver-only R_A becomes a second regime; primary moves to R_COMP FREE (sibling) + E2-DT. This switch is declared here before the drift result is known.
shrink_order: DT panel (DT keeps solver route on prover-built gold)
z3: 2 s per pair; UNKNOWN = not equivalent and counted; 10 s sensitivity rerun on UNKNOWN pairs if > 5%
